Of Paul’s Danger

Thomas Fuller (1608–1661)

S
HIPWRACKE
 escap’t no sooner come to land
But straight another danger is at hand;
Him men a murderer count, a wondrous thing
To bite him whom y
e
 serpent would not sting.
